$comment: Pinned stable WebAssembly component toolchain, refreshed 2026-10-31. Generated bindings and component bytes require independent qualification.

rust.$wasmtimeNote: Requires Rust 1.96.0. The composition and binary tiers follow this runtime minimum; the pure tier remains at Rust 1.88.

go.$note: TinyGo 0.44 supports Go 1.27. GOTOOLCHAIN pins the supported Go; wasm-unknown and hand-written Canonical ABI keep this guest free of WASI imports.

python.$note: componentize-py --stub-wasi traps WASI inside the component. Bind reads the composed import list, which must still be only boundary:guest/footprints.

zig.$note: Stable release. The guest template targets wasm32-freestanding and writes Canonical ABI glue by hand: there is no maintained WIT generator for Zig, and the freestanding path is the only one that yields a zero-WASI component.

policy.$policyNote: Component Model 1.0 changes the ABI to lazy/multivalue. Zig cannot return multivalue across the C ABI (ziglang#16639), so the guest template is pinned to the current ABI and the JSON-string world limits the blast radius when that lands.
